# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at medium effort, 4.7× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 53.2 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.0× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 74.6 %, cost 264× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 286 sources · 886 benchmarks · 5377 measurements. Updated 2026-10-08. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.2× to 2.7× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 1.0 to 4.9 points lower on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (69.8 %, cost 330×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (69.9 %, cost 48×): 6.9× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 69.8 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 2.3× to 7.0× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 3.0 points lower and 7.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (69.8 %, cost 330×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (70.7 %, cost 50×): 6.6× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.9 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 69.8 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 18× to 87× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 7.0 to 14.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (69.8 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 62.8 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (62.8 %, cost 18×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (62.3 %, cost 87×): 4.8× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.8× to 3.2× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.7 to 11.2 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 72.9 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.9 %, cost 146×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is xHigh (73.5 %, cost 107×): 1.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 13× to 32× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 11.8 to 16.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 62.8 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (62.8 %, cost 18×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (63.3 %, cost 32×): 1.8× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 5.8× to 13× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 5.5 to 10.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.9 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 62.8 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (62.8 %, cost 18×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (65.6 %, cost 24×): 1.3× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.8× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 1.3 to 3.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (69.8 %): Fable 5's best is max at 68.0 %. To match Fable 5 at max (68.0 %, cost 333×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is xHigh (69.0 %, cost 238×): 1.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.4× what Opus 5 costs and scores 3.3 to 6.5 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Opus 5's best is max at 68.1 %. To match Opus 5 at max (68.1 %, cost 188×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (69.9 %, cost 48×): 3.9× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.1× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 9.9 to 15.6 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.9 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 57.3 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (57.3 %, cost 139×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (58.7 %, cost 15×): 9.2× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.
